samples.question: The image has four separate numbered cards in reading order: card 1 is upper-left, card 2 upper-right, card 3 lower-left, and card 4 lower-right. Read them in number order. Each card shows objects A, B, C, and D in top-to-bottom rows. The unshaded left side is OUTSIDE and the shaded right side is INSIDE. An object makes an entry only when its marker is outside on one card and inside on the next. Consider only objects inside on card 4. Which object makes the earliest entry? Answer A, B, C, or D.
